Metrics.Name: graph2otel.api.unexpected
Metrics.Description: Microsoft API responses that did not match what this collector was built against, by kind. Non-zero means an assumption needs re-checking; see the WARN log for the offending value.

Metrics.Name: purview.ediscovery.case_health.cases_covered
Metrics.Description: eDiscovery cases actually polled for case-health detail this cycle. Compare against purview.ediscovery.case_health.cases_total: covered < total means DefaultMaxCases left part of the tenant's case inventory unpolled this cycle, not that the tenant has few cases.

Metrics.Name: purview.ediscovery.case_health.cases_total
Metrics.Description: Total eDiscovery cases this tenant has, per the case list. Always emitted alongside cases_covered so partial coverage is never indistinguishable from a genuinely small tenant.

Metrics.Name: purview.ediscovery.case_operations
Metrics.Description: eDiscovery case operations across every covered case, counted by action and status. Never labeled by case or operation identity (#112).

Metrics.Name: purview.ediscovery.custodians
Metrics.Description: eDiscovery custodians across every covered case — a plain count, no field mapper. Every case observed live returns zero rows; see the package doc for why no ediscoveryCustodian shape is mapped. Absent entirely when no case's fetch succeeded, so a total read failure never reads as a measured zero (#240).

Metrics.Name: purview.ediscovery.hold_sources
Metrics.Description: eDiscovery legal-hold data sources (userSources + siteSources) across every covered case, counted by which collection the row came from and its dataSourceHoldStatus. Never labeled by case, hold or source identity (#112).

Metrics.Name: purview.ediscovery.legal_holds
Metrics.Description: eDiscovery legal holds across every covered case, counted by isEnabled and whether the hold's errors array is non-empty. legalHold.status is null on every hold observed live, so it does not bucket this gauge — see AttrHoldState on the log twin. Never labeled by case or hold identity (#112).

Metrics.Name: purview.ediscovery.noncustodial_data_sources
Metrics.Description: eDiscovery non-custodial data sources across every covered case — a plain count, no field mapper. Absent entirely when no case's fetch succeeded (#240).
